verdict.rationale: Fivetran's Connector SDK plus its AI coding-agent skills (for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) explicitly let users 'build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts,' and a Cursor AI tutorial reinforces this AI-assisted connector-authoring workflow, matching the human-reviews-then-ships pattern.  However, the evidence never shows the AI parsing arbitrary API documentation to auto-derive auth, pagination, and stream schemas, nor any hands-on example of a generated connector being reviewed and shipped. missing for 10: concrete example/demo of AI reading external API docs to produce a working connector, explicit handling of auth/pagination/streams by the AI skill, and independent verification of output quality.
